messages:
sara_m: Quick sync — landing copy pass for Hosted / Dedicated / Private + webinar landing + inbound lead routing. Need final hero lines and routing rules by EOD.
naresh_k: LGTM. Can we surface benchmarks prominently? customers ask for latency and cost numbers.
eli_g: I'll push a design variant that pairs compact benchmark tiles under hero.
jordan_d: Draft hero options:
- Hosted API: "Start inference in minutes — hosted LLMs with low-lift integration"
- Dedicated: "Reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput and SLAs"
- Private: "Self-hosted, VPC-friendly inference for regulated data"
samuel_r: For CTAs: hosted -> "Try hosted API" (fast signup); dedicated -> "Contact sales for reserved capacity"; private -> "Request private deployment".
sara_m: Webinar blurb (short): "Running LLMs in production: choosing Hosted, Dedicated, or Private deployments" — 60min, demo + benchmarks + customer panel. Date: May 12, 11am PT. Signup: https://redwood.com/webinars/hosted-vs-dedicated-vs-private
naresh_k: Lead routing rules proposal:
1) If message contains "SLA", "compliance", "on-prem", "private" -> route to enterprise-sales@redwood.com + AE queue
2) If trial signup + estimated <$5k/mo -> self-serve onboarding flow
3) Webinar signups with "enterprise" tag -> followup by Solutions SE (2 business days)
Also add UTM params: utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=tri_mode_may
eli_g: Small copy tweak for benchmark tile (concise):
```
P50 latency: ~90ms
GPU throughput: ~400k tokens/hr (per GPU)
Unit cost example: $0.XX per 1k tokens
```
jordan_d: Can we get Legal to review the SLA and cost phrasing? avoid hard guarantees on cost or performance.
sara_m: Action items: eli -> update hero mockups; jordan -> validate copy w/Legal; naresh -> wire routing rules in HubSpot; samuel -> update CTA destinations + email templates. I'll collate into a single copy deck and send by 4pm. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder: webinar landing template deployed to staging at 2026-05-01T16:00Z
samuel_r: Proposed short benchmark narrative for the landing page: "Redwood delivers predictable latency and throughput across deployment modes — low-latency hosted endpoints for rapid iteration, reserved capacity for throughput-sensitive workloads, and private deployments for strict data controls. Benchmarks shown are example medians; results vary by model and input length."
sara_m: Thanks team — will drop final copy in Google Drive and ping here when ready.
